notes: Hard blockers gate GO_FOR_CALIBRATION. Warnings are diagnostics. Reliability bands are comments, not a single GO floor. Collection-ready is not calibration-ready.

preferredReviewedCharts.rationale: Preferred corpus so school and cohort slices are not empty.

minReviewedCaseSchoolNamPhai.rationale: Actual Nam Phái reviews, not eligibleSchools.

multiReviewerCaseSchoolCount.rationale: (caseId, school) units with enough actual overlapping reliability units.

minOverlappingUnitsPerMultiReviewerCaseS.rationale: Two reviewers rating disjoint palaces is not inter-rater overlap. Require ≥3 shared case+school+palace+axis units with usable (non unable-to-judge) ratings.

minUsablePairwiseComparisons.rationale: LEFT/RIGHT/TIE only. UNABLE_TO_JUDGE does not inflate readiness.

requiredGlobalReliabilityAxes.rationale: Stage A tunes quality normalization of support−pressure into net-quality. Those three channels must be computable.

krippendorffSingleFloor.rationale: Do not use one global alpha cutoff as the only GO condition. Bands: NOT_COMPUTABLE; COMPUTABLE_WEAK <0.40; COMPUTABLE_MODERATE <0.67; COMPUTABLE_STRONG ≥0.67. Weak but computable still reports honestly.

cohortRequirements.vcd: Represent VCD charts where school VCD policy is sufficiently resolved.
cohortRequirements.structuralSystem: Represent at least one chart tagged structural-system once enough cases exist.
